subject.title: Skills silently truncated - user-created skills invisible with no warning or prioritization

question: Should OpenClaw solve this issue by landing only omitted-skill lookup recovery now, or should core also add priority/pinning and user-visible truncation warning semantics in the same product direction?
rationale: Current source shows the narrow omitted-key recovery is concrete, while priority, pinning, required-skill, and user-visible warning behavior would add or change skills config and prompt-selection contracts.

options.title: Land Omitted-Key Recovery First
options.body: Use the open omitted-key PR or an equivalent narrow fix for recovery, and keep priority/pinning tracked as a separate product/config decision.

options.title: Define Priority and Warning Contract Now
options.body: Sponsor a broader core skills config/UX design that covers pinned or required skills plus user-visible truncation warnings before implementation.

options.title: Defer Core Config Expansion
options.body: Keep current allowlists and prompt-budget docs as the supported workaround while only accepting future core changes with stronger product evidence.

recommendation.title: Land Omitted-Key Recovery First
recommendation.body: Use the open omitted-key PR or an equivalent narrow fix for recovery, and keep priority/pinning tracked as a separate product/config decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills-loading release history and live follow-up on the omitted-key PR make this the best available routing candidate from the current evidence.
